name: OLIFE reflection transfers and deliver() inflate the pair's balance
summary: OLIFE is a reflection token whose transfer fee and public deliver() shrink the reflected supply, raising every non-excluded holder's balance, including its OLIFE/WBNB pair's, without a sync. The attacker bought OLIFE with 969 flash-loaned WBNB, transferred it to itself 19 times and delivered the rest, then swapped the pair's inflated OLIFE balance out for 1,001.3 WBNB.
notes: The owner's later excludeFromReward calls (blocks 8008538-8155538) excluded four other wallets, not the pair, before renouncing ownership at block 8176325; the deployment is the reset.

Campaign: every transaction moving WBNB out of the OLIFE/WBNB pair from creation to the present; before the anchor the largest net outflow was 6.2 WBNB, ordinary sells in the launch weeks, and the anchor emptied the pair. Loss is the pair's net WBNB outflow; its OLIFE is valued at nothing (rule 12).
